a.lede: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warns that hackers are exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability (CVE-2026-5430) affecting multiple products from enterprise software provider WSO2. [...]
a.title: CISA warns of Sharepoint, WSO2, Adobe Commerce flaws exploited in attacks

b.lede: The ShinyHunters extortion gang is using a URL-encoding trick to bypass web application firewall rules that mitigate the Oracle PeopleSoft CVE-2026-35273 flaw, allowing the threat actors to resume widespread exploitation of a flaw on vulnerable servers. [...]
b.title: ShinyHunters uses WAF bypass trick in Oracle PeopleSoft attacks
